title: Experiment pi-herdr dependency and rename swarm package to shortleash
description: Use @andrewjacop/pi-herdr as an explicit dependency experiment instead of only shelling out to the Herdr CLI. Rename the swarm extension/package and its Beads metadata contract to shortleash, updating package names, commands, documentation, fixtures, settings, and tests without leaving stale swarm identifiers where they are product-facing.
design: Prefer a clean cutover for product-facing names while preserving generic swarm terminology only where it describes orchestration semantics. Inspect the actual pi-herdr exports before choosing direct imports; do not invent APIs.
acceptance_criteria: - package metadata and import paths use the shortleash name consistently; - Beads metadata.shortleash is the only supported configuration key and the shared resolver and CLI/TUI use it; - @andrewjacop/pi-herdr is represented in dependency metadata and the experiment's integration boundary is explicit; - real package tests, type checks, builds, and focused Beads/OMP smoke validation pass; - stale product-facing swarm names are either migrated or documented as compatibility-only;

title: Complete Herdr-backed swarm pane lifecycle
description: Validate and complete the requested Herdr integration for Beads-triggered Swarm runs. Reuse pi-herdr's battle-tested CLI primitive shapes, open one tab with a dashboard and wave agent panes, close completed panes before opening the next DAG wave, preserve in-process fallback, add deterministic tests and user documentation, and verify against the installed Herdr binary.
acceptance_criteria: Claiming a swarm-configured Bead autoruns through one Herdr tab; the dashboard and current runnable wave panes are visible; completed panes close before the next wave opens; the same tab is reused across diamond waves; unavailable Herdr falls back safely; pi-herdr command compatibility is covered; tests and a real Herdr smoke pass.
notes: Implemented Herdr-backed claimed-run integration with one reusable tab, dashboard pane, DAG-wave pane rotation, in-process fallback, injectable control seam, and public exports. Added deterministic lifecycle tests and user docs. Verified with bun run check:types, bun test (65 pass), Biome check, targeted Herdr bundle, and real Herdr binary smoke. The installed OMP 17.2.5 binary leaves Herdr agent_status idle/state_change_seq unchanged after agent prompts; the CLI adapter now submits OMP prompts without --wait and polls pane output until the active Running marker clears, while retaining the standard agent wait command for other agent kinds. Minimal real smoke completed 2/2 agents through one Herdr tab.
close_reason: Herdr-backed swarm lifecycle is implemented, tested, documented, and verified against the installed Herdr binary.

title: Implement durable workflow journal and authoritative operations
description: Add the durable workflow event journal, authoritative state reducer, structured plan/evidence/obligation/evaluation operations, restart recovery, projection reconciliation, and OMP wiring for the obligation-driven workflow runtime.
acceptance_criteria: The runtime commits idempotent durable events, reconstructs state after process restart, rejects transitions with unsatisfied obligations or evaluator failures, preserves plan integrity, exposes structured runtime operations, and reconciles Beads projections without treating manual closure as completion.
notes: Implemented authoritative JSONL workflow journal and reducer, durable plan/evidence/decision/evaluation/obligation operations, idempotent event handling, recovery and snapshot safety, Beads projection/reconciliation, OMP structured tools, CLI start/resume/inspect/evaluate/reconcile, reference workflow, architecture/integration docs, and scoped test script. Verified bun run test (6 pass), bunx tsc --noEmit, Bun builds, and real OMP RPC tool loading; full direct bun test is contaminated by nested oh-my-pi tests and Bun 1.3.13 incompatibilities.
close_reason: Implemented and verified durable workflow runtime, OMP structured integration, Beads projection/reconciliation, recovery, docs, and scoped tests.

title: Fix missing swarm dashboard after Beads claim
description: After claiming a Bead with metadata.swarm from the scratchpad workspace, swarm automation runs and Alt+A can enter the worker context, but Alt+W does not open the swarm dashboard and the prompt-area status widget is absent. Diagnose the real OMP TUI lifecycle and restore dashboard overlay/widget visibility without breaking existing swarm execution.
acceptance_criteria: Alt+W opens the live swarm dashboard during a metadata-backed claim; the dashboard is right-anchored with graph/status/action content; the prompt-area widget is visible while the run is active; Alt+W closes the overlay cleanly; focused tests and a real scratchpad OMP smoke pass.
notes: Attached the dashboard controller to the actual claimed-swarm lifecycle in src/extension.ts and src/swarm/auto.ts. Focused dashboard, renderer, controller, and auto-runner tests; full swarm-extension tests; type checks; and Biome checks pass. Real package-root OMP smoke from the scratchpad claimed a temporary metadata.swarm Bead. While the worker bash sleep ran, prompt output showed swarm:scratchpad-dashboard-claim-smoke running 0/1 and running 1/1 with Alt+W dashboard. Alt+W rendered Execution graph, Recent native actions, and worker bash status. A second Alt+W closed the overlay. The worker completed with 0 errors and the temporary fixture was closed.
close_reason: Dashboard/widget lifecycle restored and verified by focused tests plus a real metadata-backed Beads claim smoke.

title: Integrate metadata-driven swarm claims
description: Add a strict metadata.swarm schema for Beads create/update and automatically delegate claimed configured Beads to the swarm executor. Keep metadata validation shared across direct extension calls and eval bridge calls, preserve existing Beads authority boundaries, and prove the end-to-end claim path with deterministic tests and an OMP smoke.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria

- Feature, bug, and task Beads create/update inputs validate metadata.swarm against the existing swarm definition schema.
- Invalid swarm metadata is rejected before bd create/update is invoked.
- Existing metadata remains preserved and non-swarm metadata remains uninterpreted.
- Claiming a Bead with valid metadata.swarm invokes the swarm executor with the Bead's task context and does not start a swarm for unconfigured Beads.
- Duplicate/repeated claims do not launch duplicate execution for the same issue unless an explicit retry policy allows it.
- Direct tool execution and eval bridge calls use the same validation path.
- Tests cover valid/invalid metadata, create/update transport, claim delegation, and no-config behavior; package-root OMP smoke proves the registered tool path.
notes: Implemented strict metadata.swarm validation across client/tool paths, metadata-file handling, and automatic claim delegation. Added guard preventing non-swarm metadata from replacing configured issues. Verification: bun biome check --write src/beads/client.ts test/beads/tool.test.ts; bun run check:types; bun test (59 pass); real OMP metadata claim smoke completed; same-session repeated claim returned already-completed without duplicate execution.
close_reason: Metadata-driven Beads swarm claims implemented and verified with deterministic tests, real OMP delegation, and repeated-claim recovery.

title: Keep Beads renderer host-independent
description: Remove the host ToolDefinition API change used by the Beads renderer. Use only the existing public extension renderer options so the swarm extension remains self-contained and does not modify OMP source.
acceptance_criteria: The coding-agent host source has no Beads-specific modification; the Beads extension typechecks and tests pass; pending and completed Beads rendering does not visibly duplicate call/result cards.
notes: Removed mergeCallAndResult from the host ToolDefinition and Beads registration. renderBeadsCall now returns an empty component once isPartial is false, using only the existing public renderer options; pending calls remain framed and completed results render once. Verification: 51 tests pass, extension and host typechecks pass, targeted Biome checks pass, and real OMP package-root smoke showed one completed Beads frame with DESCRIPTION and METADATA.
close_reason: Beads renderer is self-contained and no longer modifies or depends on an OMP source API change

title: Polish Beads tool UI rendering
description: Add a custom Beads tool call/result renderer using the OMP extension UI contracts: framed headers, theme colors, markdown-rendered issue cards, and compact operation summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Beads calls render with a bordered tool header; results use theme colors and Markdown for issue fields, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and metadata; collapsed output remains bounded and expansion remains usable; the extension loads and all existing tests pass.
notes: Implemented src/beads/render.ts with themed framed call/result cards, Markdown issue sections, metadata JSON, friendly status/priority/age fields, compact operation summaries, and collapsed-list expansion hints. Added mergeCallAndResult support to the host ToolDefinition contract and registered Beads renderer. Added focused renderer tests. Verification: bun test (50 pass), bun run check:types (pass), targeted Biome checks (pass), and real OMP package-root smoke showed the Beads framed card with DESCRIPTION and METADATA.
close_reason: Beads tool UI renderer and host merge contract implemented and verified

title: Fix Beads dependency semantics
description: Correct create.deps orientation, make dependency removal report a real no-op or not-found result when the requested edge does not exist, and document dependency traversal direction in the tool description/schema.
acceptance_criteria: create.deps makes the new issue depend on each listed dependency; removing a missing or reversed edge is not reported as successful removal; direction down/up is described in the tool-facing guidance and covered by tests.
notes: Fixed create.deps by creating first, then issuing explicit bd dep add new_issue dependency_issue --type type; this avoids bd create --deps orientation reversal. Dependency removal now preflights the down edge, detects reversed orientation, rejects missing edges, and verifies the edge is gone after bd dep remove. Clarified deps orientation and direction down=dependencies/up=dependents in the top-level description and Zod schema. Added regression tests. Verified bun run check, bun test (47 passing), real dependency add/remove smoke, and missing-edge rejection.
close_reason: Corrected dependency orientation, removed false-success behavior, documented traversal direction, and verified tests plus real Beads operations.

title: Expand Beads tool guidance
description: Make the top-level Beads OMP tool description self-sufficient for agents: document the operation set, required fields, common workflows, safety boundaries, and the distinction between Beads projections and authoritative workflow state.
acceptance_criteria: The tool description gives agents enough guidance to choose operations and construct valid inputs without exploratory clarification calls; it accurately documents supported fields and workflow boundaries.
notes: Expanded createBeadsTool's top-level description to a 3,345-character agent-facing guide covering authority boundaries, all operations, required fields, dependency semantics, metadata transport, validation constraints, common ready/show/claim/update/close workflow, and structured examples. Verified bun run check, bun test (45 passing), and runtime description smoke.
close_reason: Expanded self-service Beads tool guidance and verified the full extension suite.

title: Fix duplicate ArkType scope during extension load
description: Loading the swarm-extension package with omp --extension currently fails before startup with: A Scope already named Array already exists. Identify the duplicate module or schema registration, fix the extension loading path without removing the public Beads tool, and add a reproducible smoke check.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria

- The exact omp --extension package-root invocation loads without the duplicate Scope error.
- The swarm extension still registers /swarm and the discoverable beads tool.
- A focused regression check covers loading the extension in the supported OMP runtime context.
- Existing swarm-extension tests and type checks remain passing.
notes:
Reproduced by the user's exact package-root --extension invocation; investigating duplicate ArkType scope ownership before changing code.
Root cause: the extension imported ArkType directly, so OMP's host loader resolved a second ArkType package/scope registry. Switched the tool schema to the host-re-exported zod/v4 runtime, removed the extension's direct arktype dependency, and added test/omp-loader.test.ts. Verified bun run check, bun test (45 passing), and exact omp --extension package-root startup with /swarm help and no scope-loading error.
close_reason: Host-compatible schema runtime fixed duplicate ArkType scope; focused loader regression, full checks, and exact package-root OMP smoke pass.

title: Expose unified Beads OMP tool
description: Register one discoverable OMP beads tool with explicit show, list, ready, create, update, claim, close, and dependency operations. Route through an argv-based Beads adapter, validate direct and eval-bridge calls, support nested metadata via temporary files, and keep workflow authority separate from Beads projections.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria

- The extension registers one discoverable beads tool with the agreed operation set.
- Reads and mutations use --json through an argv-based adapter; arbitrary bd commands are not exposed.
- create/update support structured metadata and workspace-relative metadata_file transport.
- claim is explicit ownership only and never starts a swarm.
- Operation-specific validation runs inside execute for direct eval bridge calls.
- Tests cover representative reads, mutations, invalid operations, metadata transport, and claim semantics.
- Existing swarm Beads input and projection behavior remains intact.
notes:
Implementing the unified public beads tool with internal adapter methods; root Beads workspace was recreated because the checkout had no active database.
Implemented src/beads/client.ts and src/beads/tool.ts, registered one discoverable strict beads tool, added argv/JSON validation and metadata transport tests. Verified bun run check, bun test (43 passing), and a real bd show smoke call through the tool.
Aligned optional close reason and inspected CLI flags for parent/type/defer/priority/assignee; reran bun run check and bun test (44 passing), plus real bd show/list/ready tool smoke calls.
close_reason: Unified discoverable Beads tool and CLI-parity adapter are complete; validation, metadata transport, claim semantics, registration, full tests, and real bd smoke calls pass.
